posts.cooked:
""ketigid"":

The problem with this box is, it will not hold the cards from the next expansion.

Not sure what you mean by “next expansion”; the box will hold the cards from the Enhanced Edition, Rook City, Infernal Relics (which is currently the “next expansion”), and the promo decks (Unity and Ambuscade), and all the counters provided with the Enhanced Edition.

Yeah, this box won’t hold the expansion after that, but seriously, we have to be realistic about our options. :-\ The next box they provide will likely have enough space to hold another few sets.

It’s not like we can get a constantly-expanding box that’ll fit every set as it comes out.
